change: v74: the page works without a network: a service worker keeps every file of the site (194) in the browser, so after the first visit the page opens at once and also offline; a new version is fetched in the background and the page offers to reload into it. The page can be installed (manifest, icons, 安装到桌面) and shows 离线 in the header with no network. The welcome leads with opening an ET file (button, Ctrl+O, F3, or a file dropped on it). The keys of ET 2017, read from its own menus: V 全屏, X 缩小, Z 放大 (box an area, or Shift + click; the right button ends it), C 屏幕移动 (one drag), F10 前画面, F7 单片全屏, Ctrl+X 恢复, F2 保存, F3 and Ctrl+O 打开, Ctrl+P 打印 (出图); the page's V and C went to them. 帮助 (?) lists the page's keys beside ET's, the sentences the built-in assistant understands, and offline use.
validation: Node tests (77 scripts and 7 other suites), 39 real-browser suites with 2003 checks. v74: the menus of ET 2017 were read with window messages (503 items, 29 with a key) and every key the help gives ET is the key of that command in its menus; ET's view commands were run as its menus run them and the page does what ET did. The service worker ran in a sandbox (every file kept, where each request is answered from, a new version taking over); in a real browser the page opened from it while the site answered nothing, and drafted trousers there. Every earlier comparison with ET was made again with this code, and every earlier answer of the model examination was replayed with it.
limits: v74: ET's Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+6 switch tabs in a browser and are not taken; Alt+A, Alt+S, Alt+Z and Alt+C have no key in the page yet; keys pressed in ET did not reach its commands, so what ET does on a key was seen once only (the prompt of Z); offline, the assistant's model service cannot answer and the built-in instructions are used. v73: the assistant does not set the rules of 自动改裤长; a target length is not taken. The model was not called through the service with a key.
